    What you are looking at

    These are the finished pages themselves, not pictures of them. The questions open, the header sticks as you scroll, the buttons respond, and the layout is the real desktop layout at 1440 px.

    One thing is deliberately inert: the estimate form does not send anywhere in a preview. Wiring it to a destination is part of going live.

    Two things we need from you

    • Confirm the offers

      Every page publishes four: a free dual sump pump with every whole house French drain, 12% off for military and first responders, 0% APR financing up to $200,000 subject to approval, and a free no obligation estimate. Confirm these are current and approved as written, with particular attention to the financing figure.

    • Decide how calls get tracked

      Every page dials (201) 646-5936 directly, 8 links per page. That works, but paid search calls will not be attributed to the ads that produced them. If you want that reporting, we need either a dedicated tracking number or a number swap script in place before launch.
